name: GL_AUTORUN_RUN_ERRORS
description: This table keeps track of all of the system and validation errors that have occurred during the automation run.

columns.name: AUTORUN_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Automation run request that launched the job that reported this error or launched the chain of jobs that reported this error.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAIL_INDEX
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: PROGRAM_CODE
columns.description: Process that returned the error.

columns.name: AMOUNT_KEY
columns.description: Key that uniquely identifies the set of data that was summed to get the amount impacted by this failure.

columns.name: ERROR_TEXT
columns.description: Detailed error message associated with the error.

columns.name: ERROR_KEY
columns.description: Key that in combination with the amount key and detail error message, uniquely identifies the error.

columns.name: REPORTED_BY_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Actual request that reported this error. Or in the case of a system error detected by the new automation process, the request that failed.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Detailed error that was encountered.

columns.name: ERROR_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Error category that the detailed error is associated with.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount impacted by this failure in the primary currency of the ledger.

columns.name: INCOMPLETE_AMOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount is unknown or incomplete.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Name or other attribute or set of attributes that uniquely identifies the transaction in a user-friendly way.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger impacted by this failure. Defaults to -99 if the error does not depend upon a specific ledger.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAIL_CHAR1
columns.description: Additional supporting information that can be used for reporting and error correction. Contents of this column will vary depending upon the error code.

columns.name: REPORTED_FLAG

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Journal source of the transaction with the error. For example: Spreadsheet, Manual, or Payables.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date, referenced from Oracle Fusion General Ledger, used to determine the accounting period of a transaction.
